app.name: GI Compass
app.tagline: A guided symptom questionnaire, reviewed by a doctor

standingNotice.notADiagnosis: This service does not diagnose. A registered doctor reviews everything you tell us before any result reaches you.
standingNotice.seekCare: If your symptoms are severe or getting worse, do not wait for this review — seek care in person.

home.assuranceLanguageBody: The whole questionnaire, and the summary you receive, are available in English and Hindi.
home.assurancePrivacyBody: You choose, separately, what your information is used for, and you can withdraw any of those choices at any time without losing access.
home.assuranceReviewBody: Nothing reaches you until a registered medical practitioner has read your answers and written their own opinion. The software never decides anything on its own.
home.assuranceReviewTitle: A registered doctor reads every case
home.heading: Tell a doctor what is going on, before you sit down with them
home.intro: Answer a guided set of questions about your symptoms and upload any reports you already have. A registered doctor reviews your answers and writes back with what they think and what to do next.
home.step1Body: The questions adapt to your answers, so you are only asked what is relevant to you. Pictures help where a description is hard.
home.step2Body: Lab results, endoscopy or scan reports, discharge summaries, prescriptions. A photo of a paper report is fine.
home.step2Title: Add any reports you already have
home.step3Body: A registered doctor reads your answers, forms an impression, and tells you what they suggest next. Nothing reaches you until they have reviewed it.
home.step3Title: A doctor reviews it and writes back

auth.adultsOnly: This service is currently for adults. If you are under 18, please see a doctor directly.
auth.assuranceDoctor: Every case is reviewed and signed off by a registered medical practitioner before you see anything.
auth.assuranceFooter: GI Compass is decision support for a doctor. It is not a diagnosis and it does not replace an in-person examination. If your symptoms are severe or getting worse, seek care in person now.
auth.assuranceHeading: A guided questionnaire, read by a registered doctor.
auth.assuranceLanguage: Answer in English or Hindi, on any phone, at your own pace.
auth.assurancePrivacy: You choose how your information may be used. Clinical access is controlled by role and recorded in the audit trail.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.loginIntro: Sign in to continue where you left off.
auth.mfaBody: Accounts that can see patient records need a second factor. You cannot open a case until this is set up.
auth.mfaCannotScan: Cannot scan? Enter this key by hand
auth.mfaQrAlt: QR code for setting up your authenticator app
auth.mfaScanBody: Use any authenticator app — Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, or your password manager.
auth.mfaScanHeading: Scan this with your authenticator app
auth.mfaSignInBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short phrase you will remember works better than a short complicated word.
auth.registerIntro: You will need an email address you can open right now to confirm it.
auth.resetIntro: Choose a new password. This link can be used once.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in an hour.
auth.verifyFailed: That link is no longer valid. It may have been used already or expired.
auth.verifySent: Check your email. We have sent a link to confirm your address — it expires in 24 hours.
auth.verifySuccess: Your email address is confirmed. You can sign in now.

login.invalid_credentials: That email address and password do not match.
login.unverified: Please confirm your email address first. Check your inbox.
login.suspended: This account is not active. Please contact us.
login.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.

verify.invalid_token: That link is no longer valid.

reset.invalid_token: That reset link is no longer valid. Please ask for a new one.

refresh.replay_detected: For your security we signed you out of every device. Please sign in again.

mfa.already_enrolled: A second factor is already set up for this account. Contact an administrator to reset it.
mfa.not_enrolled: No second factor is set up yet. Reload this page to start.
mfa.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check your authenticator app and try the current code.
mfa.secret_unreadable: Your second factor cannot be read on this server. An administrator needs to reset it.

profile.dateOfBirthHint: Some questions and safety checks depend on your age.
profile.doctorIntro: Your account as it appears on the cases you review.
profile.doctorManagedByAdmin: Your name and registration are managed by your clinical administrator. Ask them to change anything here — a reviewer editing the name that appears on a released summary would put attribution outside the audit trail.
profile.emergencyContactHint: Only used if your answers suggest you need urgent care.
profile.heading: A few details about you
profile.intro: The doctor needs these to read your answers properly. Your name and phone number are stored encrypted.

consent.heading: What you are agreeing to
consent.intro: Each of these is a separate decision. You can say yes to some and no to others, and you can change your mind at any time from your privacy settings.

account_processing.title: Store my answers and my account
account_processing.explanation: We keep what you tell us so a doctor can read it and so you can come back to it. Without this we cannot store anything at all.
account_processing.withdrawal: Your account and everything in it would be closed and deleted.

ai_assisted_analysis.title: Use an AI system to prepare a summary for the doctor
ai_assisted_analysis.explanation: An AI system reads your answers and prepares a structured summary to help the doctor review your case faster. It never decides anything, and you never see its output — the doctor does, and they can disagree with it.
ai_assisted_analysis.withdrawal: Your case still goes to a doctor. They read your answers directly, without a prepared summary.

share_with_assigned_doctor.title: Share my answers with the reviewing doctor
share_with_assigned_doctor.explanation: The doctor assigned to your case can read your answers and any reports you upload.
share_with_assigned_doctor.withdrawal: No doctor can read your case, so it cannot be reviewed.

case.branchOpened: Your answer added some follow-up questions.
case.chooseAreaIntro: Pick the one that fits best. You will be asked about other things as we go — you do not need to work out what is wrong.

emergency.doNotWait: Do not wait for an app review or finish this questionnaire before seeking help. This application does not provide an emergency response service.

documents.scanPendingHint: We check every file before your doctor can open it. This one is still being checked.
documents.tooLarge: That file is larger than {maxMb} MB.

privacy.heading: Your privacy
privacy.rightsIntro: You can ask for a copy of your data, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it.
privacy.requestExport: Ask for a copy of my data
privacy.requestErasure: Ask us to delete my data
privacy.erasureWarningBody: This removes your answers, your uploaded reports, and any summary the doctor released. A record of who accessed your data is kept, without your name, because we are required to keep it.
privacy.requestSubmitted: We have your request. We will be in touch.

doctor.reviewPanelHint: Your clinical judgment & patient care plan
doctor.assessmentAbsent: No AI summary for this case
doctor.assessmentAdoptSteps: Use these as my next steps
doctor.assessmentAdoptStepsHint: Copies them into your own next steps, where you can edit them. Medication is never suggested here and cannot be released.
doctor.assessmentDifferentialHint: Ranked possibilities with the findings behind each. Not a diagnosis — your finalised impression is the only part of the record that may state one.
doctor.assessmentDisclaimerShort: Decision support for you. Never shown to the patient.
doctor.assessmentFailed: The analysis could not be produced
doctor.assessmentRedFlagsHint: Separate from the deterministic red flags on the left, which were raised before any model ran and are not the model's to change.
doctor.assessmentRunningHint: Analysing this case. The local model reloads automatically after idle sleep, so the first request may take longer. Keep this page open; you can continue reviewing the record.
doctor.assessmentUngrounded: No curated guidance matched this presentation — this summary is ungrounded.
doctor.assessmentWorkupNotReleased: Decision support only. Review and edit these suggestions in the sign-off panel before releasing them.
doctor.attentionEmptyBody: Every case assigned to you has been reviewed and released.
doctor.diagnosisHint: Your own clinical conclusion. This is the only place one may be stated.
doctor.dietaryAdviceHint: What to eat, avoid, or change. No medicines.
doctor.differentialEmpty: Nothing listed yet. Add a condition below.
doctor.doctorOnlyHeading: Your notes — not shown to the patient
doctor.doctorOnlyHint: Your reasoning and anything for the record. The patient never sees this.
doctor.documentUnreadableDetail: Automatic extraction could not read this file. The original is still attached and the patient supplied its type and date.
doctor.extractUnverified: AI-generated and unverified. Read it against the original before relying on any value in it.
doctor.extractVerified: A clinician has confirmed this extract against the original.
doctor.finalizedBody: Dispatch it to the patient when you are ready.
doctor.finalizeSucceeded: Signed off. You can now dispatch it to the patient.
doctor.followUpIntervalHint: When to come back, for example "in six weeks".
doctor.groundingChunks: {count, plural, one {# grounding passage} other {# grounding passages}}
doctor.historyIncompleteNotice: The patient started this section but did not finish it. Treat anything blank as unasked rather than as absent.
doctor.historyNotRecorded: No medical background was captured for this case. The patient was not asked, or opened this case before the step existed — this is not the same as reporting nothing.
doctor.impressionHint: Editable clinical reasoning. Verify any AI-assisted draft against the patient’s record.
doctor.metricOverdueCaption: {count, plural, one {# case waiting longer than {hours} hours} other {# cases waiting longer than {hours} hours}}
doctor.patientFacingHint: Only the version you finalize and explicitly dispatch becomes visible to the patient.
doctor.patientSummaryHint: Review and edit the draft into clear guidance for the patient. Finalizing records your clinical approval.
doctor.pdfFallback: This browser cannot display the PDF inline.
doctor.precautionsHint: What the patient should watch for, and when to seek care in person.
doctor.previewUnavailable: No preview is available for this file type.
doctor.queueEmptyBody: No case is assigned to you and none is waiting to be claimed.
doctor.queueFilteredEmptyBody: Clear the filters to see the whole queue again.
doctor.queueTableCaption: Cases awaiting or under review, most urgent first
doctor.redFlagsIntro: Raised by clinician-authored rules before any AI ran. The patient has already been advised.
doctor.referral_none: No referral needed at this time
doctor.referral_within_week: See a doctor in person within one week
doctor.releaseConfirmBody: This is exactly what they will see. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
doctor.releasedBody: This chart is locked. The text the patient received is frozen as it was sent.
doctor.saveFailed: Your review could not be saved.
doctor.triageLead: Cases assigned to you, and cases waiting for someone to take them.
doctor.unassignedEmptyBody: Every submitted case has a doctor responsible for it.
doctor.unassignedIntro: These were submitted with no doctor assigned. Claim one to take responsibility for reviewing it.
doctor.yourDifferentialHint: Start from the model’s list or replace it. Every change you make is recorded against the original.
doctor.editableAiDraft: AI-assisted draft · Review and edit these notes, confirm the clinical assessment, and finalize before dispatch. Prescriptions are entered by you.
doctor.aiAssistShort: Preview suggestions, then choose what to add. Your existing notes stay intact.
doctor.aiAssistHint: These are clinician-facing suggestions from the case assessment, not a diagnosis or a finished patient letter. Verify the evidence and rewrite adopted text for the patient before finalizing.
doctor.aiAssistEmpty: Generate an assessment to see suggestions here. You can also continue writing your review without AI.
doctor.aiAppendHint: This field already has text. Adding the suggestion appends it and preserves your current wording.
doctor.aiFillHint: This field is empty. Adding the suggestion creates an editable, unsaved draft.
doctor.aiAppendSummary: Append to summary · keep my text
doctor.aiAppendWorkup: Append new steps · keep my text
doctor.aiDraft_duplicate: Already included. No duplicate text will be added.
doctor.aiDraft_limit: This addition exceeds the field limit. Review and shorten your draft manually; no text has been changed.
doctor.aiDraft_empty: No suggestion is available for this field.
doctor.aiManualFields: Diagnosis, prescriptions, referral urgency and private notes are not changed by these actions. Applying a suggestion does not save or send anything and requires fresh approval before dispatch.
doctor.aiApplied: Added to your unsaved draft. Review and finalize again before dispatch.
doctor.recordAnswerCount: {count, plural, one {# response} other {# responses}} · expand to review
doctor.prescriptionHint: Physician-authored only. Record medication, dose, route, frequency, duration and relevant precautions.
doctor.workupHint: Review every suggested action. One action per line, up to 12.

doctor.unsavedNavigation: This draft has unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?

shell.clinicianNotice: GI Compass is decision support. The AI assessment is a set of possibilities with a likelihood, never a conclusion, and it is never shown to a patient.
shell.clinicianNoticeAuthority: A clinical conclusion reaches a patient only when you write it and release it.

history.conditionsHeading: Conditions you have been diagnosed with

history.familyHint: Gut conditions or cancers in your parents, brothers, sisters or children.
history.heading: Your medical background
history.intro: This is the part a specialist most often has to ask for in person. Anything you can tell us here saves time later. Every field is optional.
history.medicationsHint: Include anything you buy without a prescription — painkillers, antacids, ayurvedic or herbal preparations. These matter more than people expect.
history.notesHint: Anything about your health you think the doctor should know.
history.prefilledNotice: We have filled this in from your last consultation. Please check it is still correct.
history.saved: Your medical background has been saved.
history.saveFailed: We could not save that. Please try again.
history.surgeriesHint: Especially anything on your stomach, gut, liver or gallbladder.
history.trajectoryHint: Use your own words. Approximate dates and medicine or home-remedy names are useful. Reports are optional.
history.trajectory_onset: When did you first notice it?
history.trajectory_impact: How does it affect eating, sleep or daily activities?
history.trajectory_remedies: What medicines, OTC products or home remedies have you tried?
history.trajectory_response: Did these help? Did the problem return?
history.trajectory_previousConsultations: Have you seen anyone about this? When, and what were you told?
history.confirmMissingHeading: Check the sections you left empty
history.confirmMissingHint: An empty section means we do not know. Select none only if you can confirm it.
